PHONE_TARGET.what: phone in landscape, the 1920 x 820 content shown full width, held at 30 cm (the M2.6 target)
PHONE_TARGET.photometry_note: 100 cd/m^2 and 100:1 are pcond's defaults (the display the frozen stack targets), NOT a measured phone; a real OLED phone has a much deeper black and 500-1000+ cd/m^2 peak. The viewer's actual phone is unknown.

DESKTOP_TARGET.what: 27-inch 2560 x 1440 monitor at 60 cm, content shown 1:1 (1920 px wide = 39.7 deg)
DESKTOP_TARGET.photometry_note: a generic SDR office monitor in a dark room (ColorVideoVDP's standard_4k photometry), not a measured display

SCENE_GEOMETRIC.what: reference only: the image fills the camera's own 60 deg field (true angular sizes); used by T2 FLIP and M2.5

rule: every metric or model that accepts viewing geometry gets it explicitly from this file; no silent defaults
